definition.description: Definition: what behavioral pattern it captures, in 1-2 sentences.

relationship_to_existing.description: Relationship to existing codes: 'New', 'Subcode of X', 'Overlaps with Y'.

referenced_entities.description: Entities from the database that were referenced in this analysis. Populated by the orchestration layer for traceability.

segment_ids.description: Segment IDs referenced in this output.

code_ids.description: Category/code IDs referenced in this output.

hypothesis_ids.description: Hypothesis IDs referenced in this output.

incident_ids.description: Incident IDs referenced in this output.

document_ids.description: Document IDs referenced in this output.

needs_retry.description: true if you consider your output is incomplete, low quality, or requires additional refinement

retry_reason.description: ONLY if needs_retry=true. CONCRETE and ACTIONABLE instruction on what to improve in the next attempt. E.g.: 'Label too generic — specify distinctive properties', 'Missing evidence from segment 47', 'Definition mixes two different concepts — separate'

suggested_action.description: Recommended action: proceed (output correct, continue), retry (retry with feedback), escalate_to_hitl (human decision needed), skip (skip this agent, not relevant), abort (unrecoverable error, stop everything)
